kind_of_thing.quote: An airplane (American English), or aeroplane (Commonwealth English), also plane, is a fixed-wing aircraft that is propelled forward by thrust from a jet engine, propeller, or rocket engine.

kind_of_made_thing.why: Airplanes are used to carry people and goods from place to place, so they are vehicles.

where_it_travels.quote: Airplanes fly between many cities all over the world, carrying people and cargo.
